definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 'initial program: A program that is placed into the initial state every time the program is called'; 2023 gives the same attribute by the INITIAL clause (11.10) and D.6.4.3. The programs SR6 governs (RECURSIVE inside an INITIAL program, directly or indirectly) are the same; covered at --std 2002 by pb1507 and the reader's probes.
